title.value: Model-Invariant State Abstractions for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: The paper focuses on introducing a new type of state abstraction called model-invariance in the context of model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL).
title.quote: In this paper, we exploit this property with a causal invariance perspective in the single-task setting, introducing a new type of state abstraction called model-invariance.

extractions.description: The paper introduces a new type of state abstraction called model-invariance for model-based reinforcement learning. It aims to improve generalization by leveraging causal sparsity and invariance in the dynamics models. This involves learning model-invariant representations that can generalize to unseen states and improve sample efficiency across various continuous control tasks. The paper presents theoretical and empirical results demonstrating improved generalization and discusses the practical methods for learning such representations in complex domains.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily deals with improving machine learning models in reinforcement learning, which is not directly related to sustainable development themes such as climate change or ecological sustainability.
